content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the write's fail decision (tkwuyxux) for the write it abandons after, and the abandon mechanism (urtkpxwv) for the change it discards — without either, a birth that cannot complete has nothing to answer to. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts a parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: A birth that cannot complete is where the write's fail decision meets the abandon mechanism; the gate keeps the rule sound over both without testing the refusal itself. The report failures — the crossing reports no usable id, or a malformed one — are hard to force, since the crossing always reports an id, so they stay covered by the rule's text and this gate rather than by a behavioural case.
